name: Levyso Cognetti
bioAdditions: 'Levyso Cognetti (b. 1930)' is not a separate person. The only source behind the entry is the 1940 census of 612 Philo Street, Scranton (Ward 2, E.D. 71-15 on the image header, sheet 13B), where Frank and Helen Cognetti's household lists the sons Ralph, Salvatore, Joseph, Anthony, John and 'Leopo' (son, 10, born Pennsylvania, at school, grade 5) and the daughter Mary (S1). FamilySearch's index transcribes the name as 'Leupo' (S1), and the Ancestry tree's 'Levyso' is a further misreading of the abbreviation 'Leopo' for Leopoldo. A 10-year-old in April 1940 fits Leopold Salvatore 'Leo S.' Cognetti, born 19 May 1929 (S2). No other son of about that age appears in the household, and Leo is already in the tree as H0346. He died at home in Exton, PA, on 1 Jul 2019 (S3). The record should be merged into H0346 and the 'presumed living' flag dropped.

conflicts.assessment: The 1930 year comes from the census age; Leo's draft card gives 19 May 1929.
This is a minor citation discrepancy; the header on the image as read should be preferred.
